sharedRules.name: The Shadow of Chaos
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is CHAOS DAEMONS, your deployment zone is within The Shadow of Chaos. At the start of each phase, if you control at least half of the objectives in no man's land, no man's land is within The Shadow of Chaos until the end of the phase (evaluated once at that time). At the start of each phase, if you control at least half of the objectives in your opponent's deployment zone, your opponent's deployment zone is within The Shadow of Chaos until the end of the phase (evaluated once at that time).
When a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit takes a Battle-shock test, if your Army Faction is CHAOS DAEMONS, while the triggering unit is within The Shadow of Chaos, add 1 to the triggering unit's Battle-shock rolls; if the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, unless the triggering unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, one model in the triggering unit regains up to D3 lost wounds; if the triggering unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, return D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) to the triggering unit, each with its full wounds remaining.
When an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test, if your Army Faction is CHAOS DAEMONS, while the triggering unit is within The Shadow of Chaos or while the triggering unit is within 6" of a friendly unit with the BLOODTHIRSTER, GREAT UNCLEAN ONE, KAIROS FATEWEAVER, KEEPER OF SECRETS, LORD OF CHANGE, ROTIGUS, SHALAXI HELBANE or SKARBRAND keyword, subtract 1 from the triggering unit's Battle-shock rolls; if the triggering battle shock roll was a failure, the triggering unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Daemonic Pact
sharedRules.description:
Your army can include LEGIONES DAEMONICA units.
Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA units cannot be your Warlord.
Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA units cannot be given Enhancements.

  - You can re-roll the Advance roll.
  - You can re-roll the Charge roll.
  - This model ignores any modifiers to its Move characteristics.
  - This model ignores any modifiers to its Charge and Advance rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Fight phase, you can use this ability, if this model has destroyed one or more enemy models this phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 1" to this unit's Move characteristic.
Applies to: LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
If this unit charged this turn, until the end of the phase, this unit is eligible to fight from up to 3" away.
Applies to: LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 2 to this model's Wounds characteristic.
Applies to: LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER units (excluding MONSTER units).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Improve this unit's Strength characteristic by 1.
Applies to: LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem or when you target this unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, reduce the CP cost of that use of the Stratagem by 1 CP, to a minimum of 0 CP.
Applies to: LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE units.
